arxiv-2012-04601.title: σ \sigma -Stable Matrices
arxiv-2012-04601.creator: Michael A.S. Thorne
arxiv-2012-04601.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Michael A.S. Thorne. σ \sigma -Stable matrices are introduced and it is shown that the real roots of the polynomials comprising the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial indicate the coefficient sign changes. A proof of Obrechkoff is then used to show that the largest real root from the coefficients is the point of stability when the maximal eigenvalue of the σ \sigma -stable matrix is in ℝ \mathbb{R} . Some implications of the coefficient behaviour for a scaling relation are then discussed.

arxiv-2207-10293.title: Affective Behavior Analysis using Action Unit Relation Graph and Multi-task Cross Attention
arxiv-2207-10293.creator: Dang-Khanh Nguyen, Sudarshan Pant, Ngoc-Huynh Ho, Guee-Sang Lee, Soo-Huyng Kim, Hyung-Jeong Yang
arxiv-2207-10293.description: Abstract Facial behavior analysis is a broad topic with various categories such as facial emotion recognition, age, and gender recognition. Many studies focus on individual tasks while the multi-task learning approach is still an open research issue and requires more research.

arxiv-2310-08891.title: EHI {\rm EHI} : End-to-end Learning of Hierarchical Index for Efficient Dense Retrieval
arxiv-2310-08891.creator: Ramnath Kumar ramnathk@google.com, Anshul Mittal me@anshulmittal.org, Nilesh Gupta nileshgupta2797@gmail.com, Aditya Kusupati kusupati@google.com, Inderjit Dhillon isd@google.com, Prateek Jain prajain@google.com
arxiv-2310-08891.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ramnath Kumar ramnathk@google.com, Anshul Mittal me@anshulmittal.org, Nilesh Gupta nileshgupta2797@gmail.com, Aditya Kusupati kusupati@google.com, Inderjit Dhillon isd@google.com, Prateek Jain prajain@google.com. Dense embedding-based retrieval is widely used for semantic search and ranking. However, conventional two-stage approaches, involving contrastive embedding learning followed by approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS), can suffer from misalignment between these stages. This mismatch degrades retrieval performance. We propose End-to-end Hierarchical Indexing ( EHI {\rm EHI} ), a novel method that directly addresses this issue by jointly optimizing embedding generation and ANNS structure.

arxiv-2403-20186.title: Sketch-to-Architecture: Generative AI-aided Architectural Design
arxiv-2403-20186.creator: Pengzhi Li 1, Baijuan Li 2, Zhiheng Li 1 1 Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University, Shenzhen, China 2 Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, China
arxiv-2403-20186.description: Abstract Recently, the development of large-scale models has paved the way for various interdisciplinary research, including architecture. By using generative AI, we present a novel workflow that utilizes AI models to generate conceptual floorplans and 3D models from simple sketches, enabling rapid ideation and controlled generation of architectural renderings based on textual descriptions.

arxiv-2404-11376.title: From Image to UML: First Results of Image-Based UML Diagram Generation using LLMs
arxiv-2404-11376.creator: Aaron Conrardy, Jordi Cabot
arxiv-2404-11376.description: Abstract In software engineering processes, systems are first specified using a modeling language such as UML. These initial designs are often collaboratively created, many times in meetings where different domain experts use whiteboards, paper or other types of quick supports to create drawings and blueprints that then will need to be formalized.

arxiv-2405-15720.title: Study of triaxial loading of segregated granular assemblies through experiments and DEM simulations
arxiv-2405-15720.creator: Venakata Rama Manoj Pola, Ratna Kumar Annabattula
arxiv-2405-15720.description: Abstract A simple position-dependent body force-based confinement for simulating triaxial tests using the Discrete Element Method is presented. The said method is used to perform triaxial simulations on mono-disperse and segregated assemblies of glass spheres. The macroscopic load response obtained in simulations is validated with experimental load response.

arxiv-2406-15789.title: Privacy Implications of Explainable AI in Data-Driven Systems
arxiv-2406-15789.creator: Fatima Ezzeddine
arxiv-2406-15789.description: Abstract Machine learning (ML) models, demonstrably powerful, suffer from a lack of interpretability. The absence of transparency, often referred to as the black box nature of ML models, undermines trust and urges the need for efforts to enhance their explainability.

arxiv-2410-17364.title: Opinion dynamics model of collaborative learning
arxiv-2410-17364.creator: Jibeom Seo, Beom Jun Kim
arxiv-2410-17364.description: Abstract We propose a simple model to explore an educational phenomenon where the correct answer emerges from group discussion. We construct our model based on several plausible assumptions: (i) We tend to follow peers’ opinions. However, if a peer’s opinion is too different from yours, you are not much influenced.

arxiv-2503-11428.title: The π 0 → γ ∗ ​ γ ∗ \pi^{0}\to\gamma^{\ast}\gamma^{\ast} transition form factor and the pion pole contribution to a μ a_{\mu} on CLS ensembles
arxiv-2503-11428.creator: Georg von Hippel
arxiv-2503-11428.description: Abstract We present the status of the Mainz group’s lattice QCD calculation of the pion transition form factor ℱ π 0 ​ γ ∗ ​ γ ∗ \mathcal{F}_{\pi^{0}\gamma^{\ast}\gamma^{\ast}} , which describes the interaction of an on-shell pion with two off-shell photons.

arxiv-2505-05711.title: DiGIT: Multi-Dilated Gated Encoder and Central-Adjacent Region Integrated Decoder for Temporal Action Detection Transformer
arxiv-2505-05711.creator: Ho-Joong Kim Yearang Lee Jung-Ho Hong Seong-Whan Lee[2.5pt] Dept. of Artificial Intelligence, Korea University, Seoul, Korea[-1pt] {hojoong_kim, yr_lee, jungho-hong, sw.lee}@korea.ac.kr
arxiv-2505-05711.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ho-Joong Kim Yearang Lee Jung-Ho Hong Seong-Whan Lee[2.5pt] Dept. of Artificial Intelligence, Korea University, Seoul, Korea[-1pt] {hojoong_kim, yr_lee, jungho-hong, sw.lee}@korea.ac.kr. In this paper, we examine a key limitation in query-based detectors for temporal action detection (TAD), which arises from their direct adaptation of originally designed architectures for object detection. Despite the effectiveness of the existing models, they struggle to fully address the unique challenges of TAD, such as the redundancy in multi-scale features and the limited ability to capture sufficient temporal context.

arxiv-2505-15651.title: Probing Scalar-Photon Coupling in the Early Universe: Implications for CMB Temperature and Anisotropies
arxiv-2505-15651.description: Abstract The Hubble tension, as a persistent discrepancy between early-time and late-time measurements of the Hubble constant, motivates explorations of new physics in the early Universe. In a recent early dark energy (EDE) model, we introduced a scalar field interacting with the radiation sector at early-time before recombination.

arxiv-2510-26097.title: Robust Super-Capacity SRS Channel Inpainting via Diffusion Models
arxiv-2510-26097.creator: Usman Akram, Fan Zhang, Yang Li, and Haris Vikalo, [0.5ex] Department of Electrical, Computer Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin, TX, USA
arxiv-2510-26097.description: Abstract Accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for reliable multiuser MIMO operation. In 5G NR, reciprocity-based beamforming via uplink Sounding Reference Signals (SRS) face resource and coverage constraints, motivating sparse non-uniform SRS allocation. Prior masked-autoencoder (MAE) approaches improve coverage but overfit to training masks and degrade under unseen distortions (e.g., additional masking, interference, clipping, non-Gaussian noise).

pmc-10739018.title: CONDITIONS ASSOCIATED WITH SUCCESSFUL IMPLEMENTATION OF AN ADVANCE CARE PLANNING INTERVENTION IN NURSING HOMES
pmc-10739018.creator: Susan Hickman, Edward Miech, Timothy Stump, Laramie Mack, Wanzhu Tu, Kathleen Unroe
pmc-10739018.description: Implementing evidence-based interventions in nursing homes is challenging in part because clinical trials requiring a controlled experimental environment are difficult to sustain. In contrast, pragmatic clinical trials develop and evaluate evidence-based interventions in the “real world” with the goal of streamlining implementation after study completion.

pmc-12427766.title: Improvement in Physicochemical and Functional Properties of Insoluble Dietary Fiber from Rice Bran Treated with Different Processing Methods
pmc-12427766.creator: Yanxia Chen, Qin Ma, Fei Huang, Xuchao Jia, Lihong Dong, Dong Liu, Mingwei Zhang, Ruifen Zhang
pmc-12427766.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rice bran represents an exceptional natural source of dietary fiber (DF), and its physicochemical properties and therapeutic potential are closely associated with its origin and processing methods. Herein, rice bran was subjected to extrusion, fermentation, and a combined treatment of fermentation and extrusion to explore the alternations in the structural, physicochemical, and functional properties of the resulting insoluble dietary fiber (IDF). All treatments induced substantial microstructural alterations in IDF, producing fiber matrices with enhanced porosity and looser architectures.

pmc-13101287.creator: Gulsah Karabulut, Vedant Mundada, Ragya Kapoor, Hao Feng
pmc-13101287.description: The design of sustainable, active packaging materials offers a promising alternative to petroleum-based plastics. ZnO NPs were synthesized via ultrasound-assisted precipitation, and curcumin was added at 0.075–0.375%.
